units.source_text: 停工的原因很多，但归根结底是由于经济问题。

en.t: There were many reasons for the work stoppage, but in the end it came down to economic problems.

units.source_text: 也就是说，生产过剩，致使库存达三十万匹之多。

en.t: In other words, overproduction had caused the inventory to reach as many as three hundred thousand bolts.

units.source_text: 停工八天，就是为了处理库存和争取改善交易。

en.t: The eight-day shutdown was meant to deal with the inventory and try to improve business terms.

units.source_text: 近来资金周转困难，也是一个很重要的因素。

en.t: Recent difficulties with cash flow were also a very important factor.
